display_name: 独立学生源域交叉拟合复滤波诊断
description: 用同记录源 clean 半窗拟合标量或 17 抽头复滤波，在另一半窗测量源 IQ 误差并双向交叉。

data.representation: 672 fixed source pilot paired received/clean IQ, frozen DURA output

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: Per-record clean-calibrated source crossfit only; not deployment, identity accuracy or general upper bound

checkpoint.initialization: Two fixed independently trained source-only spectral students and fixed DURA
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source summary/checkpoint commit, 8192/32768 fit sizes, flags, DURA teacher ancestry and disjoint source pilot
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Both students and original DURA source-only with no target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final 20-epoch checkpoints, no source or target score selection

expected_artifacts: result.json: held-out source IQ error after per-record scalar/FIR calibration

dimensions: RX4/6 and RX8 x seven views x 48

rows.method: Fit complex scalar or 17-tap ridge FIR on one clean source half, evaluate other half, swap halves
rows.purpose: Diagnose whether stationary frequency-selective errors account for direct student source distortion
rows.seed_notes: Two pre-existing independently initialized students share model seed and source data sampling rule; the 32768 source IDs include the earlier 8192, with fourfold updates.
rows.scenario: fixed previously explored source pilot grouped by RX and source simulation view
expected_artifacts: result.json: held-out source IQ error after per-record scalar/FIR calibration

notes: No F, TX, V, target IQ/truth or parameter updates.
Source clean calibration is unavailable in deployment; first and second halves exchange fit/evaluation roles.
17-tap ridge factor .001 fixed before diagnostic; fitted filters see adjacent prediction IQ at boundary but no held-out clean.
Two students use different source sizes and training exposure; source pilot previously explored, no independent target claim.
No candidate selection, hyperparameter tuning or rerun based on target outcomes.
